sources.entry: Screenbar - macOS menubar app for automating screenshots.

summary.one_liner: Screenbar is a macOS menubar app that takes screenshots automatically at a user-set interval.
summary.what_it_does: Screenbar runs in the macOS menu bar and captures screenshots on a recurring timer. The interval between captures is set in seconds. The built-in macOS screenshot sound can be turned on or off. Screenshots are saved to a folder named com.honkbarkstudios.screenbar inside the user's Pictures folder. The README describes installation from the Mac App Store or building the project from source with Xcode.
use_cases: automatically capture screen at regular intervals
record periodic screenshots of a Mac screen
monitor what is on screen over time
how_to_run: Download Screenbar from the Mac App Store, or
Clone the repository and build it yourself with Xcode
notable: Lives in the macOS menu bar
Saves to a dedicated folder in Pictures
caveats: README does not describe any settings beyond interval and sound
README does not state a license or maintenance status
